steps.en: Install the native CLI and approve required OS access
steps.zh: 安装原生命令行，批准所需系统访问

steps.en: Request the target app's interactive controls
steps.zh: 请求目标应用的交互控件

steps.en: Returns JSON controls with snapshot-qualified refs
steps.zh: 返回 JSON 控件与带快照编号的引用

steps.en: Choose an actual returned ref and request its action
steps.zh: 选取真实返回引用，请求对应操作

steps.en: Re-resolves the live target and reports delivery evidence
steps.zh: 重新解析实时目标，报告发送证据

steps.en: Snapshot again and check the intended task outcome
steps.zh: 再次取快照，检查预期任务结果

steps.en: Returns updated controls for your agent's next decision
steps.zh: 返回更新控件，供现有 agent 决策

value.en: Your agent gets native controls and action evidence without hand-built pixel coordinates
value.zh: 现有 agent 获得原生控件与动作证据，不必手工维护像素坐标
